text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them ran with all 
their heart, resolve, and pride on the 
line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The roaring cheers and the fulfilled 
expressions on the runners' faces tell the 
whole story. The excitement from today's 
race surely made the world even more 
Marvelous than it was yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't stop here. The next goal is the 
finale of the Spring Senior Triple Crown, 
the Takarazuka Kinen.
